context:
Goal: four docs-only pull requests are marked ready and merged.
Problem (rule): the guard that checks before a pull request is marked ready refuses all four, though the coordinator's own pass printed "records page is current" and "stays a draft" on each; its message names no failing check, so the cause is unknown and only you can allow skipping the guard once.
Based on (read): the coordinator's pass ran on each of the four heads, and a fresh checks run on one branch did not change the answer.
Departs from: main marks a pull request ready only after the guard's own pass — option a skips that recheck once; option b keeps it and finds the cause first.
Waiting on: your answer; the other lanes run meanwhile. If you pick a, type override 15m in the coordinator's session (a page answer does not lift the guard).

options.gain: The four docs pull requests land.
options.how: You type override 15m in the coordinator's session; it marks all four ready and the runner merges them on green.
options.label: Skip the guard's recheck once
options.lose: One second look by the guard is skipped.

options.gain: The cause is known and nothing is skipped.
options.how: The coordinator reads the guard's rule and fixes what it asks for.
options.label: Find out what the guard wants first

short: Four docs PRs: skip the ready guard once, or find the cause

shown.label: Find out what the guard wants first

title: Should the ready-mark guard be skipped once for four docs-only pull requests?
why: The pull requests are docs only and the guard names no failing check (coordinator's recommendation); b is the safer path if time allows.
